description: This file defines data models, constants, and methods related to cloud products, customers, subscriptions, invoices, and webhook payloads for the Mattermost system.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a cloud product with pricing, SKU, family, and billing details.

classes.name: UserFacingProduct
classes.description: A simplified product view for user display, including SKU and recurring interval.

classes.name: AddOn
classes.description: Represents an add-on to a product with pricing details.

classes.name: StripeSetupIntent
classes.description: Stripe model for updating payment methods.

classes.name: ConfirmPaymentMethodRequest
classes.description: Request structure for confirming a payment method update.

classes.name: CloudCustomer
classes.description: Represents a customer with billing and payment info.

classes.name: CloudCustomerInfo
classes.description: Editable info of a customer.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Customer address details.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Customer payment method details.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Represents a customer subscription with status, billing, and invoice info.

classes.name: SubscriptionHistory
classes.description: Tracks true-up events in a yearly subscription.

classes.name: SubscriptionHistoryChange
classes.description: Represents a change in subscription history.

classes.name: Invoice
classes.description: Represents an invoice with line items and totals.

classes.name: InvoiceLineItem
classes.description: Details of individual invoice line items.

classes.name: DelinquencyEmailTrigger
classes.description: Trigger for delinquency email notifications.

classes.name: CWSWebhookPayload
classes.description: Payload structure for CWS webhook events.

classes.name: FailedPayment
classes.description: Details of a failed payment attempt.

classes.name: CloudWorkspaceOwner
classes.description: Information about the user who created the workspace.

classes.name: SubscriptionChange
classes.description: Details of a subscription change event.

classes.name: FilesLimits
classes.description: Limits on total storage.

classes.name: MessagesLimits
classes.description: Limits on message history.

classes.name: TeamsLimits
classes.description: Limits on active teams.

classes.name: ProductLimits
classes.description: Limits on files, messages, and teams.

classes.name: CreateSubscriptionRequest
classes.description: Parameters for creating a new subscription.

classes.name: Installation
classes.description: Installation details with allowed IP ranges.

classes.name: Feedback
classes.description: Feedback details for workspace deletion or downgrade.

classes.name: WorkspaceDeletionRequest
classes.description: Request to delete a workspace with feedback.

classes.name: MessageDescriptor
classes.description: Internationalization message descriptor.

classes.name: PreviewModalContentData
classes.description: Modal content data structure from S3.

methods.name: IsYearly
methods.description: Checks if the product has a yearly recurring interval.

methods.name: IsMonthly
methods.description: Checks if the product has a monthly recurring interval.

methods.name: ToMap
methods.description: Converts Feedback object to a map.

methods.name: DaysToExpiration
methods.description: Calculates days remaining until subscription expiration.

methods.name: GetWorkSpaceNameFromDNS
methods.description: Extracts workspace name from DNS string.
